items.t: Lemonade vs. Root: Which Insurtech Stock Has an Edge Now?

items.t: Morgan Stanley Maintains Equal-Weight on Lemonade, Lowers Price Target to $45

items.t: 1 in 3 vet visits are a waste of your money: Chewy CEO
items.sum: Chewy CEO Sumit Singh explains to Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi how the company is trying to bring pet insurance to millions of US households after finding fewer than 2% of pets were covered.
